name: Rhode Island Fencing Academy & Club (RIFAC) Summer Camps
description_short: Summer fencing camps at the Rhode Island Fencing Academy & Club in East Providence: full-day camps (9am-4pm, ages 9-15), half-day camps (ages 8-14, including a new Fencing + Russian Math camp with the Russian School of Mathematics) and High Performance camps for advanced foil and epee fencers up to age 18. Beginners get all equipment.

sources.note: Summer Camps page: 2026 dates, full day $470 (ages 9-15), half day $295 (ages 8-14), HP I $470 (10-15), HP II $295 (12-18); bring snack and lunch

source.title: RI Fencing: Fencing Academy Rhode Island | Recreational Fencing Club | Youth Sports in Providence RI
